_: Legend buffs, redesigned (Ed, 2026-10-05; issue #87): a buff changes only her 💌 invites and her own movement, never animals; all 30 are different; a 💌 is never stronger (more of them, or they behave differently); 💌s are never stopped by scenery. While a legend gives its buff (its quest done, or happy) every witch has it. Each species' buff: name, kind (shot or move), label (the line shown when it's gained and in the buff row's tooltip), and what it does: scale (tuning numbers, times value), add (tuning numbers, plus value), mods (the 💌 and blink behaviours below, counted). Buffs stack: two of one kind count twice (scales multiply, adds and mods add), then each total is held inside limits [min, max] (a tuning path's absolute value, or mods.<name>'s count). Every 💌 that lands on an invitable animal counts (no per-animal gap since 2026-10-06), so a buff giving more 💌s invites faster too. how: the behaviours' numbers. fan: each Fan adds per letters to every shot, widening it by spread degrees. rear: letters behind her each burst, spread degrees apart. ring: every every-th burst also fires letters all round her. charge: holding fire past a burst charges for up to time seconds (after after seconds); let go above min, a volley of up to letters over spread degrees. echo: each burst fires again delay seconds later (its aim kept). charm: letters turn at homing degrees a second toward the nearest invitable animal within range metres and cone degrees of ahead. ricochet: a letter that lands turns to the nearest other invitable animal within range metres. split: a letter that lands bursts into letters small ones (radius times its radius) over spread degrees, flying range metres. boomerang: out to turn of its range, then back to her, landing again on the way; caught within catch metres. trail: a lantern dropped every every seconds, lasting life seconds, landing on any animal within radius metres. cache: one waiting letter dropped every every seconds of firing, at most max lying (oldest goes first), each lasting life seconds and flying at the first invitable animal within reach metres. orbit: letters circling her at radius metres, spin degrees a second, each flying at an animal within reach metres, back respawn seconds later. charges: blink charges recharge one at a time (dash.cooldown each), chain seconds at least between blinks. momentum: her speed times speed for time seconds after a blink. fireSlow (tuning invites.fireSlow) is her ground speed while firing; Steady takes it away.
